summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. filed Form 6-K reporting routine insider share transactions by management and their dependents during May 2026. The filing details opening/closing balances and month activity of common and non-voting shares held by the controlling group, board members, and executive officers, including a series of sell trades of non-voting shares at prices between R$17.76 and R$18.08. No corporate event such as acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring is announced or referenced. This is a periodic disclosure of internal ownership changes under Brazilian rules, submitted to the SEC as a foreign private issuer report. No special-situation event exists.
